The morphism kappa, defined in Construction 36 (phiandkappa), is a groupoid homomorphism.

Let F:G -> G' be a map of strict categorical groups, and let F~:(G,H,alpha,beta) -> (G',H',alpha',beta') denote the induced map between the associated crossed modules. Let X be a topological space and (W_i,g_ij,h_ijk) the G-valued cocycle of a principal G-bundle over X. Then composing g_ij:W_i^W_j -> G with F~_0:G -> G', and h_ijk:W_i^W_j^W_k -> H with F~_1:H -> H', yields a principal G'-bundle over X.

Let G be a group, viewed as a strict categorical group G with objects G and only identity morphisms. Let X be a topological space with an open cover {W_i}. Then constructing a principal G-bundle over X (in the categorical sense) yields a principal G-bundle over X.

Take the cover of S^2 as in Construction 39 (cathopf), and let g_ij and h_ijk be the smooth maps defined therein. Then g'_ij = F~_0 o g_ij and h'_ijk = F~_1 o h_ijk determine the transition data of the Hopf map eta:S^3 -> S^2.

Consider the action of BU(1) on the total categorical space P of the categorical Hopf map, P x BU(1) -> P, given on objects by ((v,r),1) |-> (v,r) and on morphisms by ((v,(m,[a]),r),[b]) |-> (v,(m,[a+b]),r). Then the quotient categorical space P/BU(1) is equivalent, as a categorical space, to S^3.

Let M be a simply-connected smooth manifold and omega/2pi an integral closed 2-form on M. (i) There exists a principal U(1)-bundle pi:P -> M with a connection zeta whose curvature is omega. (ii) Given two principal U(1)-bundles pi:P -> M and pi':P' -> M with connections zeta and zeta' having the same curvature omega, there exists a morphism psi:P -> P' of principal U(1)-bundles such that [psi^*zeta'] = [zeta]; moreover psi is unique up to multiplication by elements of U(1).

Let G be a Lie group acting smoothly on a simply-connected smooth manifold M, leaving an integral closed 2-form omega/2pi on M invariant. Then there exists a central extension G~ of G by U(1) canonically associated to the pair (M,omega).
The connection zeta defined in Equation (connonHopf), zeta = -ydx + xdy - wdz + zdw, is invariant under multiplication by elements of S^3.
The group of symmetries of the Hopf map eta:S^3 -> S^2 is isomorphic to Spin^c(3).

Let M be a 2-connected smooth manifold with an integral closed 3-form nu/2pi^2. (1) There exists a principal BU(1)-bundle J:Q -> M with a connection Omega whose curvature is nu. (2) Given two principal BU(1)-bundles J:Q -> M and J':Q' -> M with connections Omega and Omega' having the same curvature nu, there exists an anafunctor Psi:Q -> Q' such that [Psi^*Omega'] = [Omega]; moreover Psi is unique up to a transformation, which is unique up to multiplication by elements of U(1).

Let M be a 2-connected smooth manifold with an integral closed 3-form nu/2pi^2, and let G be a Lie group acting on M leaving nu/2pi^2 invariant. Given a principal BU(1)-bundle J:Q -> M with a connection Omega whose curvature is nu, there exists an anafunctor Phi:Q -> Q covering the action of G on M such that [Phi^*Omega] = [Omega].
